Browse everything logged or uploaded to a record in one place: test results, metrics and files. The **{{< fa database >}} Data** page shows this evidence on its own, whether or not it is placed in a document.

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}
- [x] The record you want to explore is registered in the inventory.[^1]
- [x] Test results and metrics have been logged to the record with the {{< var validmind.developer >}}.[^2]
- [x] You are a [{{< fa code >}} Developer]{.bubble} or assigned another role with permission to read the record.[^3]

:::

## View record data {#view-record-data}

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa cubes >}} Inventory**.

2. Select a record or find your record by applying a filter or searching for it.[^4]

3. In the left sidebar that appears for your record, click **{{< fa database >}} Data**.

4. Select the tab for the evidence you want to review:

   - **Test Results**[^5]
   - **Metrics**[^6]
   - **Attachments**[^7]

### Test Results {#test-results}

The list on the left shows every test logged to the record, grouped by category such as **Data Validation** or **Model Validation**, with a pass or fail icon on each row.

- Use **Search test results** to find a test by name.
- If the record's tests belong to more than one document, select a document from the drop-down to scope the list to it. Results that are not in any document are listed under **Not in a document**.
- A record with many tests shows the first page of results. Search to find the rest.

Click a test to open its latest run on the right:

- The heading shows the test's title and ID, with a link to the document it belongs to.
- The run menu lists every run of the test, with the date and time, who ran it, and whether it passed. The newest run is tagged **Latest**. Select a run to view that version.
- **Parameters**, **Results** and **Figures** show what the selected run logged.

::: {.callout}
Links from an AI-drafted block's **Evidence used** list open here, on the exact run the draft read.[^8]
:::

### Metrics {#metrics}

The list on the left shows every metric logged to the record, grouped by category such as **Classification**, **Custom** or **Integration: Bedrock**.

Click a metric to see its name, key and the date it was last recorded, with the same values over time view as a metric block in a document.[^9]

### Attachments {#attachments}

The table lists every file on the record: files in the record's attachment fields and PDFs uploaded as documents.[^10] For each file you can see its name, field, type, size, description, when it was added and who added it. Click a file's name to open it.

To add files, click **{{< fa arrow-up-from-bracket >}} Upload Files**, select the attachment field to keep them in, then drag files in or click **choose files**. Any file type is accepted, up to your organization's upload size limit. Files over the limit are named and left out, and the rest still upload.

Click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** on a file to **Edit Details**, which updates its description, or to **Delete** it. These actions are available for files in attachment fields you can edit. PDFs uploaded as documents are managed from their document.[^11]

If the record's type has no attachment field, the tab tells you so. A [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble} can add one from **Manage Record Fields**.[^12]
